kuvalich.comm.lotus.lich_born.1: Tenno, a Lich has woken in the Kuva, wielding a %3$s, and it knows your scent. From now on, it will come looking for you.
kuvalich.comm.lotus.lich_born.2: Tenno, a new Lich has marked you. It carries a %3$s. Don't wait for it to choose the moment. Uncover the remaining murmurs and end it yourself.
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.birth.1: %1$s! Remember that name, friend. Wherever you go from now on, it goes with you.
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.birth.2: I crawled out of the Kuva, and the first thing I saw was you. What luck, friend.
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.birth.3: See this %3$s? Want it? Come and take it. I'm betting you can't.
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.arrive.1: Friend! It's been too long. Did you miss me?
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.arrive.2: We meet again! I cleared my whole day just for you.
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.arrive.3: %1$s has arrived! Skip the applause, friend. Kneeling will do.
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.arrive.4: Finding you was no trouble at all. You hide about as well as you fight.
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.arrive.5: Come on, friend. Today's show has only one star, and it's me.
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.ultimatum.1: A scrap of paper to summon me? Fine, friend. I'll humor you.
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.ultimatum.2: Looking for me? What a coincidence. I was looking for you.
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.ultimatum.3: Walking right up to me? Brave. Shame bravery won't save you.
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.downed.1: Oops, lost my footing. Don't take it seriously, friend.
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.downed.2: Come on, come closer! Let's see if you got those Requiem cards in the right order.
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.downed.3: Kneeling isn't surrendering. Come near, and I'll get right back up.
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.downed.4: Fine, fine, that round's yours. The next one is mine.
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.stab.1: Ngh... you don't hold back, do you, friend!
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.stab.2: Ha... ha, is that it? Put some muscle into it!
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.stab.3: That... that hurts nicely! Still not nearly enough.
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.fail.1: Wrong! Ha ha, friend, your Requiem cards are a complete mess!
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.fail.2: Thanks for the treat! Every mistake you make makes me stronger.
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.fail.3: The Kuva is laughing, friend. Can you hear it? It's laughing at you.
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.fail.4: That order? Did you set it with your eyes shut? Next time we meet, I won't be the one you fought today.
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.fail.5: The blade went in, just in the wrong place. Farewell, friend!
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.fail.6: Thought I was done when I fell? Up I get! The Kuva won't let me leave the stage so soon, friend.
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.vanquished.1: So... you really did solve it... Beautifully done, friend...
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.vanquished.2: My Queens... this time... I lost...
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.vanquished.3: Don't gloat... the Kuva holds... thousands more of me...
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.vanquished.4: Ha... the curtain falls... so quickly...
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.vanquished.5: Friend... that weapon... use it well for me...
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.unclaimed.1: Not coming? Then I'm leaving, friend. Don't dawdle like that next time.
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.unclaimed.2: You missed your best chance! Ha ha, see you around!
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.unclaimed.3: Going soft? You'll regret that, friend.
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.depart.1: So fast! All right, that's enough fun for today.
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.depart.2: All hidden? I'll come looking for you soon enough.
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.depart.3: No fun when you hide. Don't keep me waiting so long next time.
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.killed_you.1: Stay down, friend. Next time, bring your brain along.
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.killed_you.2: Down already? I was only warming up!
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.killed_you.3: Ha! Don't worry, I won't let you die for good. You still owe me a long game.
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.killed_you.4: Sleep tight, friend. When you wake, we'll play another round.
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.you_died.1: Who said you could die to someone else? Your life is mine!
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.you_died.2: Friend, dying like that is an embarrassment to me.
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.you_died.3: Taken out by that? Next time you die, do it in front of me.
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.confiscate.1: Oh, that's a nice one. I'll take it. Thank you, friend!
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.confiscate.2: Stop looking, I have it. Want it back? Come and get it.
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.confiscate.3: One for you, one for me. Perfectly fair.
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.confiscate.4: Call it a storage fee, friend. Nothing gets lost with me.
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.confiscate.6: Hmm, good taste. Pick something pricier next time.
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.idle.1: How have you been, friend? I think about you all the time.
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.idle.2: Another Thrall down? You do know how to please me.
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.idle.3: Where are you hiding? I'll count to ten... no, never mind, I'm coming now.
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.idle.4: The Kuva burns hotter by the day, friend. Guess why.
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.idle.5: How many murmurs have you solved? Take your time. I'm in no hurry.
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.idle.6: Sleep with one eye open, friend.
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.idle.7: Every Thrall that falls goes on your tab. I'm keeping count.
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.idle.8: The Queens gave me eternity, friend. What did they give you?
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.idle_furious.1: Enough games, friend. Now I'm truly angry.
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.idle_furious.2: The Kuva burns in my veins! I can't wait to see you!
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.idle_furious.3: I'm not laughing anymore, friend. You've made me angry.
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.archive.1: Digging into my past? Look closely, friend. I'm looking at you too.
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.archive.2: Memorize this face. You'll see it every time you close your eyes.
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.archive.3: Studying so hard? Too bad no book teaches you how to kill me.
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.archive.4: How you order your Requiem cards is your business, friend. Getting it wrong is my entertainment.
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.converted.1: You could have killed me... Friend. Today, at last, I mean it when I call you that.
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.converted.2: You are leaving the %3$s behind? Very well. From now on, I am the blade in your hand.
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.ally_arrive.1: Beaten this badly? Lucky for you I was passing by, friend.
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.ally_arrive.2: Step aside, friend. This act is mine now.
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.ally_kill.1: That is one. Are you keeping count, friend?
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.ally_kill.2: Is that all it had? I was far more trouble than that in my day.
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.ally_downed.1: Ah, a misstep. The rest is yours, friend. Do not embarrass me.
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.ally_downed.2: I will go on ahead! Hold on, friend. I will be back.
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.ally_leave.1: Nothing left to fight? Then I am off to rest, friend.
kuvalich.comm.lich.jovial.ally_leave.2: The show is over. When there is more excitement, I will be back.
kuvalich.comm.lich.logical.birth.1: I am %1$s. From this moment, every step you take is within my calculations, adversary.
kuvalich.comm.lich.logical.birth.2: The Kuva gave me form, and a purpose. You.
kuvalich.comm.lich.logical.birth.3: The %3$s is in my hand. The probability that you take it from me is... low.
kuvalich.comm.lich.logical.arrive.1: Location confirmed. Your hiding place shows no imagination.
kuvalich.comm.lich.logical.arrive.2: I am here, adversary. On time, as predicted.
kuvalich.comm.lich.logical.arrive.4: I have mapped every pattern of your movement.
kuvalich.comm.lich.logical.arrive.5: Running only delays the outcome. It does not change it.
kuvalich.comm.lich.logical.ultimatum.1: You summoned me? An interesting choice. Not a wise one.
kuvalich.comm.lich.logical.ultimatum.2: You moved this meeting forward. The result will not change.
kuvalich.comm.lich.logical.ultimatum.3: Summons received. I am here to end this pointless chase.
kuvalich.comm.lich.logical.downed.1: A momentary imbalance. Do not misunderstand, adversary.
kuvalich.comm.lich.logical.downed.2: You brought me down. Now put your reasoning to the test.
kuvalich.comm.lich.logical.downed.3: Kneeling is not defeat. Are your Requiem cards in the right order?
kuvalich.comm.lich.logical.downed.4: By the odds, your blade is more likely to miss.
kuvalich.comm.lich.logical.stab.2: The damage... is within acceptable limits.
kuvalich.comm.lich.logical.fail.1: Incorrect reasoning. I calculated this outcome long ago.
kuvalich.comm.lich.logical.fail.2: Your failure is my data. I am stronger than before.
kuvalich.comm.lich.logical.fail.3: That is your answer? Wrong, without a shred of doubt.
kuvalich.comm.lich.logical.fail.4: Wrong again. Every error of yours brings me one step closer to immortality.
kuvalich.comm.lich.logical.fail.5: The blade fell. The answer was wrong. This meeting is over.
kuvalich.comm.lich.logical.fail.6: I fell, and I rose. What you call victory was a rounding error.
kuvalich.comm.lich.logical.vanquished.1: Impossible... my calculations... were not wrong...
kuvalich.comm.lich.logical.vanquished.2: My Queens... I have failed you...
kuvalich.comm.lich.logical.vanquished.3: You... solved it... I underestimated you, adversary...
kuvalich.comm.lich.logical.vanquished.4: The margin of error... was too great...
kuvalich.comm.lich.logical.vanquished.6: Remember... I am not... the last...
kuvalich.comm.lich.logical.unclaimed.1: You missed your moment. It will not return.
kuvalich.comm.lich.logical.unclaimed.3: If you will not act, I will not wait.
kuvalich.comm.lich.logical.depart.1: Withdrawal is your only correct decision. For now.
kuvalich.comm.lich.logical.depart.2: Distance does not protect you. It only delays.
kuvalich.comm.lich.logical.depart.3: Pursuit suspended. Next time, you will not be so fortunate.
kuvalich.comm.lich.logical.killed_you.2: This is the limit of your ability.
kuvalich.comm.lich.logical.killed_you.3: Fall. I will wait for you to stand, and strike you down again.
kuvalich.comm.lich.logical.killed_you.4: Adversary? You do not yet deserve the title.
kuvalich.comm.lich.logical.you_died.1: Dead by another's hand? Improper. Only I may end you.
kuvalich.comm.lich.logical.you_died.2: Wasteful. Your ending was mine to write.
kuvalich.comm.lich.logical.you_died.3: This death does not count, adversary.
kuvalich.comm.lich.logical.confiscate.1: Requisitioned. Your supplies are now under my allocation.
kuvalich.comm.lich.logical.confiscate.3: Everything you own will be mine in the end.
kuvalich.comm.lich.logical.confiscate.4: This is the cost, adversary. Grow accustomed to it.
kuvalich.comm.lich.logical.confiscate.5: Inefficient. Your belongings are better kept by me.
kuvalich.comm.lich.logical.confiscate.6: Another one. Your list of losses grows longer.
kuvalich.comm.lich.logical.idle.1: I am observing you, adversary. I always am.
kuvalich.comm.lich.logical.idle.2: Every Thrall you destroy reports your position to me.
kuvalich.comm.lich.logical.idle.3: You are stalling. Stalling favors me.
kuvalich.comm.lich.logical.idle.4: I have listed three of your weaknesses. Which would you like to hear first?
kuvalich.comm.lich.logical.idle.5: The Kuva does not forget. Nor do I.
kuvalich.comm.lich.logical.idle.6: How many murmurs have you solved? Your progress is too slow.
kuvalich.comm.lich.logical.idle.7: The more places you hide, the clearer your patterns become.
kuvalich.comm.lich.logical.idle.8: I do not need rest. You do.
Patience exhausted. Our next meeting will have no probing.
You are now a variable that must be deleted.
The Kuva boils. Conclusion: you end now.
kuvalich.comm.lich.logical.archive.1: Reading my file? The data is limited. The conclusion will not change.
kuvalich.comm.lich.logical.archive.2: Studying your adversary is correct. For you, it is too late.
kuvalich.comm.lich.logical.archive.3: You are searching for my weakness. I am searching for yours.
kuvalich.comm.lich.logical.archive.4: There is only one correct order for your Requiem cards. Have you found it?
kuvalich.comm.lich.logical.converted.1: You chose an answer I never calculated. From this moment, I am yours to command.
kuvalich.comm.lich.logical.converted.2: I believed there were only two outcomes: victory or defeat. You have proven there is a third.
kuvalich.comm.lich.logical.ally_arrive.1: The situation is against you. I am taking over.
kuvalich.comm.lich.logical.ally_arrive.2: Your condition is below the critical threshold. Intervening.
kuvalich.comm.lich.logical.ally_downed.1: Damage exceeds threshold. Withdrawing from combat.
kuvalich.comm.lich.logical.ally_downed.2: This time the miscalculation was mine. The rest is yours.
